option_relations.rationale: The patient's symptoms and ophthalmoscopic examination results are consistent with Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO), which is a direct match with leaf B1.1.
Macular retinal vein occlusion with chronic cystoid macular edema is a subtype of Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO), which is represented by leaf B1.1.
Branch Retinal Vein Occlusion (BRVO) is a subtype of retinal vein occlusion, which is represented by leaf B1.2, but it is not the most likely diagnosis based on the patient's symptoms.

Retinal vein occlusion is a broader class that includes Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO), Branch Retinal Vein Occlusion (BRVO), and Hemiretinal Vein Occlusion (HRVO), which are represented by leaves B1.1, B1.2, and B1.3, respectively.
